high_level_description: The image features three models standing against a plain white background, creating a minimalist and clean aesthetic. The central figure is wearing a striking black dress with a deep V-neckline and a high slit on the side, paired with black ankle boots. The dress has a sleek, modern design with a draped fabric that adds texture and movement to the outfit. To the left of the central model, another model is dressed in a black ensemble consisting of a cropped top and wide-leg pants. The top is form-fitting, accentuating the midriff, and the pants have a relaxed fit.
